messages:
Jin: FYI scheduling a short maintenance window in us-west2 Fri 03:00-04:00 UTC. Purpose: clear stale GPU drivers + rebalance node labels. Expect ~12 hosts touched in 3 waves of 4.
Ravi: Will hosted inference be on the path?
Jin: Yes — model-serving pools will be affected briefly per wave. We'll shift traffic to dedicated burst nodes and enable a light-weight fallback variant for top-throughput routes.
Tess: Can we pre-warm caches to reduce p95 spikes? Last time cold KV rebuilds caused ~4min blips.
Morgan: Recommend kv-preseed 15m before each wave and a small continuous-batch window to smooth token emission. Also add a disk-pressure check pre-cordon.
Jin: Proposed timeline:
- 02:30 UTC run preflight checks (prom, node.disk, pod restarts)
- 02:40 UTC kv-preseed canary on 2 nodes: `kubectl -n inference run kv-preseed --image=ghcr.io/redwood/kv-preseed:stable -- /preseed --pool=canary --seed=2025`
- 02:55 UTC validate canary metrics (p50,p95,kvcache-hit)
- 03:00 UTC start wave 1 (4 nodes): cordon -> drain -> reboot -> uncordon -> post-preseed
- waves every 18m, stop on SLO violations
Ravi: Cost control: how much burst spend if we use dedicated pools?
ops-bot: est. burst usage cost: ~0.4% monthly infra if fully utilized. Will alert if >0.8% during window.
Tess: Owners: wave1 Ravi, wave2 Tess, wave3 Morgan. I'll own smoke checks for wave2.
Morgan: Add `--grace-period=300` to drain for local-data eviction, and extend timeout to 12m: `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300 --timeout=12m`
Jin: Router change: temporary fallback mapping for heavy tenants to variant-light. I'll push via canary=5% and then 50% if metrics look OK.
Ravi: If p95 > 700ms for >2m or errors >1.5% pause and rollback. Pagerduty escalation per runbook.
Tess: Quick smoke script I'll run after each wave:
```
#!/bin/bash
set -e
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "https://api.internal/health?model=baseline" | grep 200
# small prompt latency check
```
Morgan: Also watch ephemeral-nvme usage and kubelet eviction logs during drain. Fail if node.disk.used% > 85%.
Jin: I'll update the scheduled maintenance ticket and post a concise support note for low-likelihood latency blips; full customer notice only if impact observed.
ops-bot: maintenance scheduled id=sm-2021791234567 start=2025-09-12T03:00:00Z notify=[#eng-infra,#support] pagerduty=on-high-error
Ravi: I'll be on preflight channel at 02:45 UTC to run checks. :eyes:
Jin: thanks team — update runbook link pinned in channel. :thumbsup:
